text_block_list.text:
The pre-summer injury had completely 
healed. There were no hindrances 
whatsoever to coaching Espoir City.

However, I won't change my coaching 
approach from summer. I'll take a step 
back and focus on supporting her.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew... Trainer, show me the 
recorded footage!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that curve in the middle leg, right?

Yeah, it's that curve in the middle 
section, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, right there! Next time, I'm 
cutting in even closer to the inside!

Even without me telling her, she already 
possesses the judgment needed to make 
improvements herself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...None of the training we did together 
was in vain.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I'll use all of it as 
reference. So I can decisively win my 
race.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Every single order and strategy you've 
taught me—I won't let a single one slip 
away!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...The day after tomorrow is finally the 
big day, huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...My old man?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
... ...Do you really have time to be 
making calls like that, you bastard?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Because it was necessary."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: "...My ba—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare apologize!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't apologize. I didn't call you for 
that."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't go callin' what happened a "waste." 
Everything up till now... made me who I 
am.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: "...I see. ............You're right."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...So, regarding next time..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Bring Mom along to watch my race next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you, too. What Espoir City is 
made of.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...See ya.
The day of the JBC Sprint.

Checking the track conditions in place of 
Espoir City, who was focusing in the 
waiting room... —I received a message and 
headed over to the reserved seats.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Thanks as always for taking 
such good care of me! ...And from my dad 
too!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Espo invited me directly, telling us 
to come watch together. ...And so,

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
What kind of upbringing did you give 
her—that girl?

Education exists to hone the ability to 
make one's own choices.

To make a choice, one needs their own 
criteria. And to build those criteria, 
knowledge is essential.

"She learned perspectives other than her 
own, comparing others' standards with her 
own and turning it into knowledge."

—And with that, she determined her own 
path.

I decided to become someone who can 
protect what matters most to me.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: And "my role as her educator" is—

text_block_list.text:
Standing before Espoir City's parents, I 
take a deep breath... and tell them.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...They've departed, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
We're so lucky that person is Espo's 
Trainer... aren't we, Dad?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're late, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, and we're supposed to enter the 
paddock soon, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So, could you see it from the stands? The 
dirt condition... How did it look?
choice_data_list: Well, if it's you, you'll be fine!
Well, you'll be just fine, I'm sure!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Rough?! Isn't that way too rough?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Whether the track's fast or heavy, I'm 
still gonna be the one who wins.
choice_data_list: That's right, you will definitely win.
That's right, you will definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Couldn't be anything else.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm heading out. You gotta move too, 
right, bastard?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Have a good one, Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!!

And so, Espoir City stepped into the 
paddock.

Seeing her dependable figure, the last 
page of the notebook is filled.

I should trust how much she's grown—and 
see her off.
